name: lazyreader
description: Reads Claude's replies aloud, highlighting each sentence as it is spoken, from the reply's start or from where you point.

engine.title: Voice engine
engine.description: edge-tts: neural voices through the edge-tts command, played with the player below. system: the platform's own synthesizer.

voice.title: Voice
voice.description: The voice's name: for edge-tts one of `edge-tts --list-voices` (es-AR-TomasNeural, es-AR-ElenaNeural, en-US-AriaNeural...); for system, the system voice's name, or empty for its default.

rate.title: Speed
rate.description: edge-tts speed, as a percentage over or under normal: +0%, +25%, -10%.

player.title: Player
player.description: The command that plays each sentence's mp3 (edge-tts engine): mpv, ffplay or paplay. The file's path goes last.

autoRead.title: Read every reply
autoRead.description: Read each reply aloud as soon as the turn ends.

speakerButton.title: Speaker button
speakerButton.description: Draw a small speaker button under each reply block that reads it from its start.
